relations.myth: Planetary powers become beneficent through Śiva's presence
relations.note: Śiva's presence makes the nine planetary powers beneficent to his devotee.

relations.myth: Brahmā appoints the grahas to distribute results
relations.note: Some ritual accounts make Brahmā appoint the Navagraha to distribute karmic results.

relations.myth: Viṣṇu governs and subordinates the planetary powers
relations.note: Vaiṣṇava traditions subordinate the Navagraha to Viṣṇu or derive their governing power from him.

relations.myth: Planetary forces enter the Goddess's protective retinue
relations.note: Śākta rituals subordinate the Navagraha to Devī or place them in her retinue and protective maṇḍalas.
Temple layouts place Sūrya centrally, surrounded by the other eight grahas.
In East Asian Buddhist adaptation, the Nine Luminaries became attendants of Tejaprabhā Buddha.
